goal: Reduce cumulative measured ATPG search cost to a D95-safe combination within 1 percent of the best cycles in the prospectively frozen pilot roster; no full-space optimum or generalization claim
decision: Finish the four concrete work packages below; do not rerun training, expand circuits, reinterpret old PASS tables as prospective inputs, or rerun the E78 Python sandbox

missing: authenticated full-H and per-H conditional full-M endpoints with charged creation attempts
proof or versioned replacement of legacy realized-count model features

work_packages.known: Reference F completion includes coverage probe, possible full-F fallback, integer linear correction and binary boundary search
missing: real per-circuit F upper pattern bounds

conditional_budget.reference_f_search_upper: 2 + U + ceil(log2(U)) for positive authenticated full-F bound U: coverage and fallback plus at most U linear and ceil(log2(U)) binary calls
conditional_budget.f_minus_one: In the inspected bracket algorithm F-1 is an already-measured low endpoint or incoming F=0 state; an extra future confirmation must be charged separately if introduced
conditional_budget.prefix_rebuild_meaning: Conservative HMF envelope charges H and M before each F call as well as initial prefix creation; no cross-candidate, cross-policy or cross-session free prefix
conditional_budget.time_scope: Only summed declared per-attempt timeout plus cleanup allowances; not a wall-time upper bound for queue/license/setup/IO/whole-session overhead
conditional_budget.coverage_of_unlisted_invocations: Not established. Any unlisted physical subprocess invalidates use as an actual execution budget

cost_reporting.attempt_clock: Versioned observed pre-INTENT-to-verified-cleanup interval from E78 is not atomic create_patterns time
cost_reporting.session_clock: Future collection must also record setup/endpoints/selection/IO/terminal accounting overhead and no-hit/censored sessions; not implemented or measured here
